messages:
maria: Heads-up — CS asked if we can include console breadcrumb + route id in audit exports so they can map "who changed routing rules" back to UI actions. They want a stable handle to tie to rollback flows. Anyone objections? :thinking:

aj: SGTM. We need to decide shape: include console_path and change_handle or embed UI metadata in 'context' field? Also need PII redaction policy. 

sam: Prefer top-level fields: change_handle (uuid), console_path, actor_display. Easier for SIEM.

olivia: +1. Also need a telemetry tag for rollouts (e.g., rollout.id) so we can link rollouts to perf regressions.

deploy-bot: export-ready: export job 2024-06-12T17:04:00Z queued by @maria :gear:

aj: For exports, quotas: estimate size per change ~1kb. For big tenants want sampling or full NDJSON. We should offer query params: sample_rate, include_redacted, since_ts.

sam: Here's an example NDJSON line we prototyped:
```
{"ts":"2024-06-12T16:58:23Z","change_handle":"ch_1a2b3c","actor_id":"u_789","actor_display":"Olivia K","action":"update","resource":"routing_policy:tenant_123","delta_summary":"route weight 10->0, fallback to cheapest-region","console_path":"/console/tenants/123/routing/456","rollout_id":"rt_555","redacted":false}
```

olivia: That looks good. For PII, actor_display should be configurable per-tenant (masking on request). We must keep actor_id for internal correlation but allow pseudonymization in exports. 

aj: Also add provenance proof link for signed change package: `proof_url` so security teams can verify identity offline.

maria: UX ask: in console we want a 'Download change bundle' button that links to pre-signed NDJSON export with filters prefilled. Need export quotas and retention note in tooltip.

sam: Question: do we include full object snapshot or just diffs? Diffs are smaller but restores need snapshots. Maybe offer both: snapshot=true/false. 

olivia: +1 offer both. Default diff with snapshot optional. 

aj: Implementation note: routing runtime needs to emit a compact change event at commit time with change_handle. The control plane will enrich with console_path and proof_url before export. 

maria: OK action items:
- aj: add change_handle to runtime commit event + telemetry rollout.id
- sam: draft NDJSON schema and sampling/query params
- olivia: spec tenant-level pseudonymization knobs
- devex: compose support blurb for customers about export quotas

olivia: I'll draft the pseudonymization policy today, will ping once ready.

sam: Putting NDJSON schema PR up for review in ~2 days. 

aj: I'll update the event contract and hook the proof_url generation. ETA end of week.

maria: Thanks team. If no objections I'll wire the console button MVP to the pre-signed export API next sprint. :thumbsup:

aj: no objections from me.

olivia: all good.

sam: fine with me.
